description_en: Queries a list of SQL tasks
name: ListDBTaskSQLJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SQL task group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206160.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: SQL任务分组ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206160.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: db_task_group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

: To view the ID of the tenant, log on to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

DBTaskSQLJobList.description_en: The list of the SQL tasks

Comment.description_en: The description of the SQL task

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the SQL task was created

DbSearchName.description_en: The name that is used to search for the database
DbSearchName.description_zh:
库搜索名。
建议您的业务不要强依赖该参数，后续版本的格式可能会发生变化

DbTaskGroupId.description_en: The ID of the SQL task group

JobId.description_en: The ID of the SQL task

JobType.description_en: The type of the SQL task

LastExecTime.description_en: The time when the SQL task was last executed

Logic.description_en:
Indicates whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:

true: The database is a logical database.
false: The database is a logical database
Logic.description_zh:
是否为逻辑库，取值：
true：是
false：否

Status.description_en:
The state of the SQL task. Valid values:

INIT: The SQL task was initialized.
PENDING: The SQL task waited to be run.
BE_SCHEDULED: The SQL task waited to be scheduled.
FAIL: The SQL task failed.
SUCCESS: The SQL task was successful.
PAUSE: The SQL task was paused.
DELETE: The SQL task was deleted.
RUNNING: The SQL task was being run
Status.description_zh:
SQL详情状态，取值：
INIT：初始化状态
PENDING：等待任务抓取
BE_SCHEDULED：待调度
FAIL：执行失败
SUCCESS：执行成功
PAUSE：暂停
DELETE：删除
RUNNING：正在执行

Transactional.description_en:
Indicates whether the SQL task is executed as a transaction. Valid values:

true: The SQL task is executed as a transaction.
false: The SQL task is not executed as a transaction
Transactional.description_zh:
是否以事务方式执行，取值：
true：是
false：否

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of the SQL tasks
